# AgenticOS personal memory evaluation data

The unmodified `memory.tsv` is the synthetic memory evaluation dataset from
AgenticOS v1.93.0, commit `bb09fedf19b10f897c6a55dbdcd76a212dc9a275`.
It belongs to the offline test suite. StartupBot does not ship this dataset
as model instructions, use it as profile data or send it to a provider.

The 50 cases cover durable preferences and decisions, corrected facts, and
statements that should not become durable memory. The case labels reflect
AgenticOS's memory evaluator. They do not by themselves prove the behavior
of StartupBot's assisted or automatic learning.
